function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data or an internet connection to look up the current time.  
If you want to find out what time it is right now in New York, you can:

1. **Check your phone/computer** – most devices display the time for multiple cities; just add “New York” or “Eastern Time” to the list.  
2. **Use a web search** – typing “current time in New York” into Google (or another search engine) will give you the exact hour/minute.  
3. **Visit a time‑zone website** – sites like [worldtimebuddy.com](https://www.worldtimebuddy.com/) or [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) show the current local time and also let you see the difference from your own zone.  

If you’d like me to explain how to convert between UTC and Eastern Time (including daylight‑saving rules), just let me know!
